Keyword match.description: Supported if ≥50% of the claim's content words appear in one passage; otherwise insufficient. Can never say 'contradicted'.

Similarity only.description: Supported if the most similar passage has similarity ≥ 0.70; otherwise insufficient. Can never say 'contradicted'.

Plain NLI.description: Retrieval + NLI with no relevance threshold and neither heuristic.

Proofread (full).description: The real system: relevance threshold, NLI, number/date check, event-alignment gate.

− relevance threshold.description: Every retrieved passage counts as relevant.

− event-alignment gate.description: Contradictions about other events are kept.

+ sentence-level NLI.description: Each passage judged by its most decisive sentence.

top_k = 1.description: Only the single most similar passage is used.

top_k = 5.description: The five most similar passages are used.
